Read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md` before proposing or changing files.

- Work only on one approved and claimed WP/RWP.
- Confirm `Sequential` or `Collaborative` mode in `tracker/assignments.json`.
- Testing findings become issues first; do not create or reprioritize WPs/RWPs.
- In collaborative mode, stay inside the assigned writable lane and never edit shared orchestrator-owned files.
- Build only affected areas and run only affected non-integration unit tests for ordinary WP/RWP work.
- Do not run unrelated full unit, frontend, mobile, or TV suites.
- Full validation is for phase closure, nightly/manual runs, workflow changes, explicit escalation, or unknown paths.
- Never commit secrets, generated runtime output, or unrelated changes.
